summary: Mailer retains content from previously sent messages

comments.content:
It was my assumption that I could instantiate a single Mailer instance to
send multiple email messages.  However, I discovered that when I do this,
*all* email messages contain the same body content -- the body content of
the first email message sent (for a particular invocation of my app within
the jvm).  Needless to say, this is a pretty critical problem.

Since I'm using a braindead email client (MS Outlook), I have no way to
confirm what the structure of the actual messages received is.  I suspect
(as one theory) that Vesijama keeps attaching new sections, so that the nth
email message has n sections, and that MS Outlook is only showing me the
first such section.  If this really is the case, it has severe security and
performance implications.

I'm sending text-only messages (no html).  Note that I'm using a slightly
patched version of Vesijama that can handle text-only email messages (see
my previous bug report; Vesijama crashes when giving it text body content
only).

Workaround -- instantiate a new Mailer for each message sent.  This
resolves my problem.

Thank you for your time to report in these issues jim.newsham.

I was under the impressions I should get e-mails from Google about issue reports. 
Now that I that I know it doesn't I'm on top of it.

I've added a fix, but haven't been able to test it yet (currently firewalled). I'll 
test this later today.
